Number Custom Fields — Edit

Create a custom field for numeric values.

Number fields are useful for tracking quantities, measurements, or other numeric data.

Name

Enter the name of this number custom field. This label appears on forms and reports.

Number fields are perfect for quantities, measurements, scores, or any numerical data.

Position

Enter a position number to control the display order. Lower numbers appear first.

Number fields appearing on line items can be totaled at the bottom of transactions.

Placement

Select where this number field should appear. You can assign it to multiple forms or line items.

When placed on line items, number fields can calculate totals. Use for quantities, weights, or measurements.

Description

Enter help text that appears below the field. This guides users on what numbers to enter.

Include units of measurement if applicable, like 'Enter weight in kilograms' or 'Number of units'.

Exclude from copying or cloning

Check this box to prevent this field's value from being copied when duplicating records.

Enable this for values that should be unique or reset to zero in duplicated records.

Locked for manual editing

Check this box to prevent this field's value from being edited by users.

This is typically used when custom field is updated by extension rather than users directly.

Minimal decimal places

Check this box to enforce a minimum number of decimal places for display consistency.

This ensures numbers always show the specified decimal places, like 5.00 instead of 5.

MinimumDecimalPlaces

Enter the minimum number of decimal places to display. Numbers will show trailing zeros to this precision.

For example, setting '2' displays 10 as 10.00, useful for maintaining consistent formatting.

Show custom field on printed documents

Check this box to show the number field value on the View screen after saving.

Important measurements, quantities, or scores should be visible without editing.

Show at the top of printed documents

If displayed on View, check this box to show the field at the top of the View screen.

Use for critical numbers that need immediate attention, like priority scores or quantity limits.

Hide total amount

Check this box to hide the total amount when this field appears on line items.

Enable this if the numbers shouldn't be totaled, like reference numbers or non-additive values.

Inactive

Check this box to deactivate this number field. It won't appear on new forms but existing data is preserved.

Historical number data remains intact and the field can be reactivated when needed.
